comment: Render-cost ceilings for scripts/perf-gate.mjs (plan §0a). Every number here is a ceiling the SwiftShader probe
(scripts/perf-probe.mjs, 1280×720, 90 frames per mode) must stay under; the per-area allocations of a phase must
fit below warnAt × budget so the sum has headroom. Formulas, per tier/mode row of the .perf JSON:
calls / triangles (mean over the sampled frames): FAIL when mean > budget × (1 + band); WARN when mean > budget × warnAt.
calls / triangles (max over the sampled frames): FAIL when max > budget × maxRatio, where maxRatio =
max(1.6, baselineMax / baselineMean × 1.1) computed per tier/mode from the reference runs (the baseline named above
and .perf/before-phase2-2026-09-05T06-21-03-274Z.json, taking the larger — tv/heli swing 2–3× between frames).
setupMs: WARN when > budget; FAIL when > budget × (1 + band.setupMs) = 1.5 × budget.
loadMs: WARN when > budget, never FAIL (dev-server dependent).
programs: the MAX over the tier's mode walk (the first sampled row of a tier is skipped — it is taken before the
shader compiles of the later modes finish) must be ≤ the tier's programs budget (FAIL above, no band).
errors[] must be empty on every row (FAIL otherwise).
'static' and 'data' are consumed by scripts/audit/scene-cost.mjs (Node, no browser, no asset pack — hence the NoAssets
suffix); measured +10 % since C5 (2026-09-11), so scene-cost runs --strict in pnpm check.
(just under warnAt, so a re-measure of the same scene is 'ok' and growth over ≈ 1 % warns), rounded up (calls to 10,
triangles to 10k, setupMs to 100); maxRatio is the documented formula over after-s2 and after-s. The C0 ceilings
(after-phase6 + headroom) predated the ground partition P3–P6 and the far field: low setupMs is now ≈ 17–19 s under
SwiftShader, of which ≈ 7.0 s is the ground plan and ≈ 7.1 s the ground meshes (README 地面の契約); the S phase's own
synchronous share is < 1 s and the deferred far field is not in setupMs at all. setupMs swings ±15 % with CPU contention
(an e2e run in parallel), which the 1.5× FAIL band absorbs. Draw calls on the high tier are 40–60 % shadow passes
(3 cascades), of which the 22 cars alone are ≈ 250; the S phase adds ≈ 200 in the overview (forest lids, buildings/solar
block merges, car-park speckle, scatter trees) — count per pass/group by wrapping renderer.renderBufferDirect.
Mode keys: 1 overview, 2 heli, 3 chase, 4 onboard, 5 tv; 6 (director) is report-only.

Re-based at the end of the R phase (2026-09-12, baseline after-r6): every tier/mode mean is that run's value +12.5 % (rounded up, calls to 10, triangles to 10k), maxRatio = max(previous, measuredMax / measuredMean × 1.1); programs = the measured max + 4 (high, the road ribbon / foliage / bark / tree impostor / GLB car / facade-normal programs) + 2 (low). The R phase adds the road ribbons (static per 1 km block), the road furniture, the pack trees (per-quadrant mesh entries, cards, mass), hero houses / cars, solar detail and the terrain-side overlays — in the overview ≈ +110 calls and +2 % triangles over after-s2, in the follow modes +10–17 % triangles from the tree meshes inside 110 m.

I7 re-base (2026-09-16, baseline after-i7-2026-09-15T15-32-08-393Z = `LABEL=after-i7 pnpm perf` on main a7e9184, the final I-phase tree with Quality.infield high propsNearM 90 / figures3dM 60): every tier/mode calls / triangles mean = that run's mean × 1.125 (rounded up, calls to 10, triangles to 10k); maxRatio = max(previous, measured max / mean × 1.1 rounded up to 0.01) — it moved on high chase (calls 1.63 / triangles 1.74), high onboard (1.76 / 2.13: the follow modes' peak frames are the pit straight with the ops layer, the terrace crowd and the 3D figures inside 60 m), high tv calls 2.95, low onboard calls 2.35, low tv calls 2.91; programs = the walk max + 4 (high: 106 → 110) / + 2 (low: 64 → 66). The walk max rose 102 → 106 (high) / 59 → 64 (low) over after-r6 against the plan's +1 (the reed cards' MeshStandard {map, alphaMap, alphaTest, DoubleSide}) to +2 estimate — no customProgramCacheKey was added in the I phase, the remaining programs are define combinations of existing materials and were not attributed one by one; setupMs = measured × 1.125 rounded up to 100 ms, as at after-r6 (high 29,123 → 32,800; low 20,394 → 23,000). Over after-r6 that is +4.7 s (high) / +3.2 s (low), measured in buildMs: the ground meshes +4.1 / +3.8 s (the 33 I5-a ground rows, the pond rings and the 20 CUT corridors' rings — 3 of them with a foot ring), the plan −2.2 / −2.0 s (the 3321af8 speed-up), the synchronous infield builders (pit / pitLane / paddock / ops / trackside / infield / cuts) +1.4 / +0.9 s; the residual +1.4 / +0.5 s is setup time outside every buildMs bucket (renderer / scene setup and run-to-run SwiftShader variance — crowd / stands / surroundings themselves fell 0.17 / 0.21 s). loadMs is kept (low 26.3 s measured under the 30 s warn ceiling; high has no ceiling — 43.5 s measured, +7.2 s over after-r6 with 177 textures instead of 134 and the pack's ops / trackside / pit GLBs, dev-server dependent). What the I phase added over after-r6, measured means: high overview calls 843 → 1,279 (+52 %: the per-cell InstancedMesh prop sets — 64 ops + 93 infield far-field entries in this browser run with the pack, 64 + 83 in the Node no-assets build — under the 3 shadow cascades) and triangles 3.00 → 3.84 M (+28 %); high chase 929 → 1,343 calls / 3.37 → 5.17 M triangles (+53 %) and onboard 933 → 1,271 / 3.18 → 4.50 M (+41 %) — the follow modes carry the pit lane's equipment, the terrace crowd and the near figures; heli +3 % calls / +12 % triangles; tv +20 % / +39 %. Low tier: overview 690 → 925 calls / 1.87 → 2.40 M, chase 534 → 780 / 1.41 → 2.02 M, onboard 476 → 536 / 1.19 → 1.61 M (one bucket per prop set, no GLB level, impostor-only figures). The static budgets (scene-cost) were re-based on the same tree at I7 (static.*.measuredAt). Re-base again only from a measured run, never by scaling these numbers.

The I phase added +737,421 tris / +115 meshes / +371 IM / +158 entries over after-r6 (3,671,971 / 893 / 734 / 991): the pit building v2 and its lane, the paddock, the ops layer (vehicles / pit equipment / figures), the marshal posts and TV towers, the infield ground rows, facilities, ponds and trees, and the cuts' walls / portals / bores / stairs / footbridges.
